script:
set -eu
printf 'UTC '; date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
printf 'Version\n'; /usr/sbin/sshd -V 2>&1 || true
printf 'Effective bounded SSH fields\n'; /usr/sbin/sshd -T | egrep '^(maxstartups|persource[^ ]*|logingracetime|usedns|loglevel) '
printf 'Load and memory\n'; uptime; sysctl hw.physmem vm.stats.vm.v_free_count; swapinfo -k
printf 'Relevant auth messages\n'; tail -n 300 /var/log/auth.log | egrep -i 'maxstartups|persource[^ ]*|drop|thrott|refus|timeout|preauth|sshguard|penalt|noauth' | tail -n 90 || true
printf 'Bounded PF rules\n'; pfctl -sr 2>/dev/null | egrep 'ssh|port = 22|port 22|max-src|overload' | head -n 40 || true
